title: Current Trends and Future Directions for Sexual Health Conversational Agents (CAs) for Youth: A Scoping Review
reasoning: The paper is a scoping review that examines the current state of research on conversational agents for youth sexual health. While it notes a lack of ethical considerations in the reviewed studies and suggests ethics as a future design guideline, it does not primarily evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith systems, or specific ethical frameworks as a core component of its research methodology.
